[![Ira Gilford Header](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/7/7a/Ira_Gilford_Header.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20080420223412)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/7/7a/Ira_Gilford_Header.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20080420223412)

**Ira Bailey Gilford** is a former Hot Wheels designer who worked at Mattel from 1967 to 1970. He is most known for designing a large number of the 1969 cars, [The Spoilers](/wiki/Category:Spoilers), the The Heavys and most notably, the [Twin Mill](/wiki/Twin_Mill), Hot Wheels's first original design.

Prior to working for Mattel, Gilford worked for the Chrysler Corporation. Gilford was recommended to the position by his friend [Harry Bradley](/wiki/Harry_Bradley), Hot Wheels's first designer. Gilford left Mattel around 1970. He currently works as an independent contractor in the digital arts field and a painter.
